name: MiniGames Hub
summary:
# 16 GAMES. PICK YOUR NEXT FAVORITE.

Sport, action, creativity and puzzles, all in one collection. Play with your hands or Meta Quest controllers. Stay in your room with mixed reality, or step into an immersive world.

## GET MOVING

**Hoop Flow:** Dribble and shoot hoops.  
**Ping-Pong Hawaii:** Serve, rally and go for the point.  
**Rebound:** Box to the beat.  
**Slope Rush:** Carve your way down the slopes.  
**Throw:** Take aim with darts and axes.
